Name: ScriptCommandPlus-Reverse Proposal And Divorce Framework
Author: Avren9
Description:
ScriptCommandPlus (SCP) A lightweight mod that adds three commands usable in Content Patcher events or other SMAPI mods:

[list]
[*]/propose — NPC proposes marriage to the player
[/list]
[list]
[*]﻿/breakup — NPC breaks up with the player
[/list]
[list]
[*]﻿/divorce — NPC divorces the player
[/list]


All in-game relationship states are updated automatically. No manual adjustments needed.

No C# coding required. No bundled content. 

It works for any character, from the vanilla game or mods, as long as they are a datable NPC.


[size=4][b]About  polygamy

[/b][/size]This optional file is intended for players using polygamy/multi-spouse mods. It modifies the core commands to ensure compatibility.

The main difference is the behavior of the /divorce command:

[list]
[*][b]Standard Version (Main File):[/b] The spouse and their room/patio are removed immediately.
[*][b]Polyamory Version (This File):[/b] To ensure safe compatibility, divorce is finalized [b]overnight[/b]. After using the command, the spouse will be gone the [b]next morning[/b].
[/list]
If you have any mod that allows multiple spouses, please download this version instead of the main file to avoid potential bugs and save file issues.

[url=https://github.com/HelriaVellon/ScriptCommandPlus]Source code available on GitHub[/url]
